name: example
description: Template showing every option. Copy, rename, and pin only what auto-detection gets wrong.
_usage: Run `spendtrack inspect statement.csv` first. It prints exactly which
columns and sign convention were detected. Only if something is wrong do
you need a profile. Save yours to ~/.spendtrack/profiles/<name>.json and
No bank-specific profiles ship with SpendTrack: export layouts change and
a stale profile is worse than detection. Build yours from a real export.
